purpose: Local two-way categorical OLS development milestone; not release qualification or a universal performance claim
science_requirements: Independent weighted explicit-dummy coefficient, covariance, RSS and output oracles
Frequency-weight literal expansion including robust and cluster covariance, effective N and singleton multiplicity
AW/PW rescaling; constant and highly unequal weights; graph-correlated weights and tiny weighted bridges
Candidate exclusion, zero/missing/invalid weights, singleton cascades and rank deficiency
Disconnected normalization and explicit adjudication of reference covariance degrees of freedom
Fresh projection certificates, pointwise output reconstruction, deterministic ordering, memory admission and failure atomicity

comparison_policy.frequency_weights: Native baseline plus independent expansion; ordinary fixest weights are not a frequency-semantics comparator
comparison_policy.reference_output_accuracy: Preserve default-reference discrepancies and separately measure matched-accuracy reference calls
comparison_policy.routing: Headline calls use auto; forced solver calls are diagnostics
comparison_policy.failures: Preserve every attempted cell and failed science or timing gate; never omit a losing graph

acceptance.required: Report each cell and family, worst ratio, reference accuracy, allocation peak, exact input/source/artifact identity and all scientific results
